rule: Wraiths drain mire-essence from lit lanterns
texts: When a wraith approaches a lit lantern, the wraith drains mire-essence from the lantern.
Whenever a wraith nears a lit lantern, the wraith pulls mire-essence from the lantern.

fields.sentence: When a wraith approaches a lit lantern, the wraith drains mire-essence from the lantern.
parse: (: wraith_drain_rule (Implication (And (Member $x wraith) (Member $y lantern) (Member $y lit) (Member $e approach) (Agent $e $x) (Theme $e $y)) (And (Member (sk_drain $x $y) drain) (Agent (sk_drain $x $y) $x) (Theme (sk_drain $x $y) mire_essence) (Source (sk_drain $x $y) $y) (During (sk_drain $x $y) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Indefinite participants correctly route bare "when P, Q" onto the whenever machinery; "lit" is treated as a modifier participle (property, unfused), approach/drain take Theme objects with Source for the from-phrase, and the During link plus 1.0/0.9 match the whenever pattern.

fields.sentence: Whenever a wraith nears a lit lantern, the wraith pulls mire-essence from the lantern.
parse: (: wraith_near_pull (Implication (And (Member $w wraith) (Member $e near) (Agent $e $w) (Theme $e $l) (Member $l lantern) (Member $l lit)) (And (Member (sk_pull $e) pull) (Agent (sk_pull $e) $w) (Theme (sk_pull $e) mire_essence) (Source (sk_pull $e) $l) (During (sk_pull $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Whenever machinery applied correctly (no QuantifierPhrase for "whenever", per-occurrence Skolem event, During link), the definite "the wraith"/"the lantern" reuse their premise variables, "lit" is kept as the modifier participle rather than lemmatized to the verb, and "from the lantern" is the motion-result Source with no Result atom. The bare mass object mire_essence is correctly a bare kind filler with its compound decomposition emitted at top level.

The adjectivally-restricted bare-plural subject correctly becomes a premise conjunct instead of a fused compound (a state/damage modifier is incidental description), and 'dimly' keeps its surface -ly form under Manner as the instruction set's brightly rule requires. Patient for the intransitive 'burn' subject follows the non-volitional-undergoer test; Agent would have been wrong for an inanimate.
